title: use_container_width=True not working for Altair facet charts

labels.name: status:confirmed
labels.description: Bug has been confirmed by the Streamlit team

body: ### Checklist - [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues. - [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue. ### Summary I'm trying to use facet charts and have them sized to fill the container. However, the charts do not get the right width when supplying `use_container_width=True`. I see two different ways they get sized, depending on how the facet is created, however neither makes the chart the width of the container. See related #4121 which I think should have fixed #3814 and #2023 (I'm not sure if there has been a regression). ### Reproducible Code Example [![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-9091) ```Python import streamlit as st import altair as alt from vega_datasets import data source = data.cars() chart = alt.Chart(source, width=100, height=100).mark_point().encode( x="Horsepower:Q", y="Miles_per_Gallon:Q", ) with st.echo(): st.altair_chart(chart.facet(column="Origin:N"), use_container_width=True) with st.echo(): st.altair_chart(chart.encode(column="Origin:N"), use_container_width=True) with st.echo(): st.altair_chart(chart.facet(row="Origin:N"), use_container_width=True) with st.echo(): st.altair_chart(chart.encode(row="Origin:N"), use_container_width=True) ``` ### Steps To Reproduce 1. run the self-contained example code 2. Observe that the code snippets are in boxes that use the container width and the charts do not use the same width. ### Expected Behavior The charts are sized to fill the container width ### Current Behavior _No response_ ### Is this a regression? - [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version. ### Debug info - Streamlit version: 1.36.0 - Altair version: 5.3.0 - Python version: 3.12.4 - Operating System: MacOS 14.5 - Browser: Safari/Chrome ### Additional Information Screenshots from running the example code. The charts are expected use the same width as the snippet boxes.
